convert_detectron_to_pytorch: convert a detectron pretrained ResNet-50 or ResNet-101 model to PyTorch checkpoint format
convert_bn_layer: convert a detectron batch normalization layer with affine channel weights to PyTorch style
convert_conv_fc_layer: convert a detectron convolution or fully connected layer weights to PyTorch style
run_conversion_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a detectron model file to a PyTorch checkpoint by specifying source, destination, and depth
check_unconverted_layers: check and print any detectron model layer keys that were not converted during the process
